column1: # Reading: the wall entropy exceeds the exact value on the expansion
column3: while ten rows off the wall it is at the exact value and upstream it is 1. On the wedge the wall reads s/s_inf = 1.0583
column10: and the exact post-shock value is 1.0299: a grid-independent excess of 2.7 per cent at the wall. This is consistent with entropy generated at the corner or tip (the wedge's leading edge is itself a corner) and convected along the wall; it is an interpretation
column11: not a proof. On the expansion the excess is the same on all three grids and the Mach number three rows off the wall is still below the exact value
column12: so the layer is thicker than three rows or something else is also at work.
